Underwriting

What we look at on a light industrial loan

  • The tenant mix and lease terms
  • Clear height, loading, power and yard space
  • Environmental history (an environmental report is common for industrial property)
  • Zoning and permitted uses
  • For owner-occupiers, the operating business
Scenarios

Common light industrial deals we see

  • A contractor buying the flex building they work out of
  • Buying a multi-tenant small-bay building
  • Refinancing a fully leased light industrial property
Light Industrial loan FAQ

Common questions about light industrial loans.

What counts as light industrial property?

Flex buildings, small-bay industrial, light manufacturing and contractor space: industrial property without heavy manufacturing or hazardous uses.

Will I need an environmental report?

Often, for industrial property. We'll tell you early in the process what your property needs.

Can my business buy the light industrial building it operates from?

Yes. Owner-occupied commercial is eligible.

What loan sizes are available for light industrial property?

Commercial bridge loans up to $20,000,000 and commercial DSCR loans up to $3,000,000, each reviewed and priced case by case.
